about: E1 golden values (design §3.7), recorded on the v1 engine and renderer at the learn-v2 base, before any learn code changed. Hashes and counts only, no entity ID. Recipe: learn/tests/golden.py. page_sha256 is golden.page_sha() of site/dist/learn/hijrah-step-by-step/index.html built by site/build.py then learn/build_learn.py on build/graph.ttl: every href and id attribute value blanked, whitespace runs collapsed, sha256 of the UTF-8 text. The gate is content_sha (design §9): the Hijrah journey's content digest in the marsad-journey export (site/dist/learn/data/journeys/hijrah-step-by-step/journey.json), recorded in stage C on the graph whose stage-A gate values (content_v1_gate, golden.content_facts(): ordered step pids, each step's entity fields, every claim about a step or behind a reason) matched. While the export's content_sha equals it, page_sha(held_page(page)) of the v2 Study page must give page_sha256; once it differs (the graph, or what the export resolves, changed) the golden test skips with 're-verify E1'. golden.held_page() is the one statement of what a held page may add (design §3.7 and §8): it takes out nav.journey-depths, the empty s-* anchor spans, and the data-depth, data-total and data-steps attributes of <article>; base-relative links need nothing, as page_sha blanks every href value. Anything else a held page adds, or any other change to it, fails the test.
